display.purpose: The studio name in the hero.

label.purpose: Spec labels, domains, and the footer.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Link nudge. The globe uses a constant slow spin instead.

motion.name: globe-spin
motion.purpose: A visible slow rotation of the hero sphere. Stops when hidden, off-screen, or reduced motion. Pixel dust shares the same loop.

components.name: Hero link
components.description: Scrolls from the hero to the product list.
components.css: .ds-hero-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-ink, #1a1a1a); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 150ms linear, transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-hero-link:hover, .ds-hero-link:focus-visible { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-hero-link:active { opacity: 0.65; } .ds-hero-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-hero-link:hover, .ds-hero-link:focus-visible, .ds-hero-link:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Visit link
components.description: Opens the product on its own subdomain.
components.css: .ds-visit { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.25rem; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--color-ink, #141414); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-visit-action { display: inline-block; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 150ms linear; } .ds-visit:hover .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:focus-visible .ds-visit-action { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-visit:active .ds-visit-action { transform: translateX(1px); opacity: 0.65; } .ds-visit-domain { color: var(--color-secondary, #454545); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-visit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-visit:hover .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:focus-visible .ds-visit-action, .ds-visit:active .ds-visit-action { transform: none; } }

components.name: Product row
components.description: One published app: name, summary, and specs.
components.html:
Chartwizard

Aplikasi desktop untuk membuat grafik dan menyaring saham di Bursa Efek Indonesia (IDX/BEI).
components.css: .ds-row { background: var(--color-paper, #f6f6f6); color: var(--color-ink, #141414); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e3e3e3); border-radius: 0; padding: 2.5rem 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--color-hover, #ececec); } .ds-row h2 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-row p { margin: 0; max-width: 38em; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Wordmark and a single link to the product list.
components.css: .ds-nav { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem; color: var(--color-ink, #1a1a1a); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9375rem; border-radius: 0; transition: opacity 150ms linear; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.22em; } .ds-nav a:active { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Specification list
components.description: Platform, market, and price beside the product name.
components.css: .ds-specs { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif); color: var(--color-ink, #141414); } .ds-specs div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.8rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #e3e3e3); } .ds-specs dt { color: var(--color-secondary, #454545); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-specs dd { margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The first screen is gray paper. Codewizard’s name sits in soft black on the left, then a sentence and a phrase that swaps: build, deploy, make it happen. On the right, a sphere of points and short links turns, drawn in the same soft black and blurred slightly. Pixel dust drifts through the hero.

The product list continues on the same paper. Chartwizard is the entry that is actually published. The footer is one copyright line. There is no contact block yet.

The palette is paper, ink, and gray. Corners stay square. Instrument Sans does every job.
keyCharacteristics: A full-viewport paper hero, then the product list on the same field
One soft-black wireframe globe, slightly blurred, paused off-screen and when the tab is hidden
Pixel dust in the hero, sparser over the type
One swapping phrase, with the first word in the HTML
Square corners, hairline rules, one type family
Bahasa Indonesia for the product list; the hero line is English

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a hue. Gray is the only secondary tone. A link is underlined, not recolored.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Do not add a serif or a monospace costume.

rules.name: The Flat Row Rule
rules.body: Hover washes the row. It does not raise it.

dos: Do add a product in `products.js` and mirror the article in `index.html`.
Do keep the globe monochrome, slow, and out of the product list.
Do keep hero type off the sphere, especially on a phone.
Do leave the footer as a copyright line until a contact block is asked for.
donts: Don't add a colored accent, a gradient fill, or a glow on the globe.
Don't put a second field color behind the product list.
Don't hide the hero sentence behind the animation or behind a failed script.
Don't invent products, prices, or screenshots.
Don't imply this studio is CODE WIZARD INC or Code Wiz.
